title: Agentic SWE Policy
description: Schema for organization or repository-level policy files that merge with pack defaults.

track_rules.description: Minimum track by changed path, checked by the work engine when leaving lean-track-check and on any --set-pipeline-track. A lower track is rejected (TRACK_POLICY).

pattern.description: Glob matched against repo-relative changed paths (e.g. 'src/auth/**'). A pattern without '/' matches the file name at any depth (e.g. '*.sql').

mandatory_subagents.description: Subagents that must have a spawn record (work record-spawn --role) when a changed path matches. Checked when leaving `phase`, and for every rule before validation -> pr-creation (MANDATORY_SUBAGENT_MISSING).

subagent.description: Subagent path under agents/subagents/. Matched to a spawn record role by file name without .md (e.g. 'quality-security/security-auditor.md' = role 'security-auditor').

phase.description: State whose exit requires a spawn recorded in that state. Omit to require it only before pr-creation.

banned_tools.description: Tools or shell command prefixes denied at runtime by the PreToolUse hook.

id.description: Stable rule name reported in deny messages and audit lines instead of the array index.

tool.description: Tool-name glob (e.g. 'WebFetch', 'mcp__github__*'), or a shell command prefix when it contains whitespace (e.g. 'git push --force').

context.description: When this is a work-item state name the rule applies only in that state; otherwise descriptive and the rule always applies.

banned_commands.description: Shell commands denied at runtime, matched as JavaScript regular expressions.

id.description: Stable rule name reported in deny messages and audit lines instead of the array index.

pattern.description: JavaScript RegExp source tested against the full shell command.

states.description: Limit the rule to these work-item states. Omit to apply always.

protected_paths.description: Files that edit tools (Write, Edit, apply_patch, ...) may not modify, matched as globs against the target path.

pattern.description: Glob matched against the target path with leading '/', drive letter or './' removed (e.g. '**/.worklogs/**/journal.jsonl').

phase_tool_allowlist.description: Per-state tool-name globs. In a listed state any other tool is denied; unlisted states are unrestricted. When repo and org policies both list a state, only tools in both lists are allowed.

required_artifacts.description: Extra files required before leaving a state, added to the work engine's built-in artifact check. An entry may list alternatives as 'a.md|b.md'; names must stay inside the work dir.

budget_overrides.description: Replace every track's ceilings from config/budget-thresholds; applied when a work item is initialised and when a track is set leaving lean-track-check.

max_doubt_cycles.description: Not enforced: no doubt-cycle counter exists. Accepted for compatibility and ignored.
